_comment: Example custom theme for cliamp mobile: noir-dawn (omarchy-echosystem/omarchy-noir-dawn-theme). Copy this file, change the hex values, and import it from Settings — themes. Every role below is required; extras are ignored. Colours are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Values marked derived are ground/ink blends in the style of the generated Omarchy themes, not colours the scheme ships.
